## Endpoints

### Data Read (7)
- `GET /{hash}` — Retrieve data associated with a specific hash.
- `GET /api/10/reviews/service` — Fetch service reviews for a specific merchant.
- `GET /api/10/reviews/summary/service` — Get a summary of service reviews.
- `GET /api/merchants/widgetintegration/all` — Get all merchant widget integration details.
- `GET /api/translations/en-US/FeefoWidget` — Retrieve translations for the Feefo Widget.
- `GET /pagead/attribution/wcm` — Get web conversion measurement attribution data.
- `GET /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php` — Access WordPress admin AJAX endpoint data.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /api/interaction/widget` — Submit widget interaction data.

### Config (1)
- `GET /web-interactives/public/v1/embed/combinedConfigs` — Retrieve combined configuration for web embeds.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Theaurorazone's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Theaurorazone data without official API access
- Automate actions on theaurorazone.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Theaurorazone frontend uses
